transport: Capture stdout and stderr separately with exact container/image/StartedAt, command bounds and complete/truncated provenance.
Use Docker API frames when available; for CLI use LF record heads without interpreting CR as records. Preserve same-stream record order and body-internal controls.

Each record carries role, stream, stream_sequence, exact RFC3339Nano timestamp and body privately. Compare integer nanoseconds, not datetime microsecond truncation. Equal timestamps across streams do not prove causal order.

True LF continuation only attributable with engine framing evidence, not a preceding-line guess. Missing first timestamp, CLI warnings, truncation, replay/gaps, unowned identity or nonmonotone same-stream timestamps stay UNKNOWN and deny.
boundary: Under fixture lock, fresh exact-owned metadata and complete both-stream baseline; bind per-stream last sequence/timestamp/digest and explicit unknown facts.

After stop/start inspect exact target state; require new startup epoch readiness/peer evidence and matching graceful shutdown where applicable. DB keeps separate unchanged-lifetime baseline.

Never reset baseline after dispatch to hide errors. Any new operation-window SQL/error/fatal, lost provenance, ambiguous boundary, incomplete startup/shutdown, or unknown peer/client fact denies and retains uncertain state.
